settings.title: A hiring partner,
settings.intro: Most agencies send you candidates. We send you the right candidate — pre-screened, vetted, and actually interested in your role.

features.title: Sector-specialist recruiters
features.text: Your account is led by a recruiter who has worked in your industry and speaks your language, not a generic call-center screener.

features.title: Deep candidate vetting
features.text: Every shortlist includes skills assessment, reference checks, and a motivation screen — so the candidate actually wants the job, not just any job.

features.title: Fast, focused shortlists
features.text: You get three to five matched candidates, not a spreadsheet of hundreds. We do the shortlisting so you don't have to.

features.title: Transparent fees
features.text: Clear, fixed placement fees with a 90-day guarantee. If a hire doesn't work out, we replace them at no extra cost.

features.title: Candidate experience that protects your brand
features.text: We treat every candidate like a future customer, so your employer brand stays strong even when a role doesn't work out.

features.title: One point of contact
features.text: A dedicated recruiter who knows your roles, your culture, and your timeline — not a rotating cast of account managers.

settings.title: Recruitment services
settings.intro: From a single hard-to-fill role to building an entire team, TalentBridge covers the full talent lifecycle.

design.title: Permanent recruitment
design.text: End-to-end hiring for full-time roles — from brief and sourcing to offer and onboarding support.

design.title: Volume hiring
design.text: For growth-stage teams hiring many people at once, we scale fast without dropping quality.

build.title: Contract & interim staff
build.text: Need someone in a role this week? We place skilled contractors and interim leaders within days, not months.

build.title: Project-based resourcing
build.text: Short-term, project-specific talent for deadlines, launches, and coverage when your team is stretched.

launch.title: Executive search
launch.text: Senior and leadership roles handled with discretion, targeted outreach, and a rigorous assessment process.

launch.title: Retained search
launch.text: For mission-critical hires, we work on a retained basis with a dedicated team and a guaranteed timeline.

settings.title: From brief to hire,
settings.intro: A simple, transparent process that gets you a great hire without the guesswork.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We start with a deep brief — the role, the team, the culture, and the real reasons the last hire didn't work. This is the step most agencies skip.

steps.title: Source
steps.text: We tap our network, job boards, and passive candidates to build a shortlist of genuinely interested, well-matched people.

steps.title: Screen
steps.text: Every candidate is interviewed, assessed, and reference-checked before you ever see them. You meet only the best fits.

steps.title: Place
steps.text: We support the offer, the negotiation, and the onboarding — and stay on hand through the 90-day guarantee period.

settings.note: Most roles are filled within four weeks of the brief. If we don't find the right person, we keep looking — and you don't pay until they start.

settings.title: Before you hire,
settings.intro: The questions hiring managers ask us most before engaging a recruitment partner.

items.question: How is this different from posting the job ourselves?
items.answer: A job post gets you applicants; we get you the right ones. We source active and passive candidates, pre-screen them, and shortlist only the people who genuinely fit and genuinely want the role.

items.question: What does it cost? What's the guarantee?
items.answer: We charge a fixed placement fee based on the role and seniority — usually a percentage of first-year salary, agreed upfront. Every placement comes with a 90-day guarantee: if a hire doesn't work out, we replace them at no extra cost.

items.question: How quickly can you fill a role?
items.answer: Most roles are filled within four weeks of the brief. For urgent contract or interim needs, we can often have someone in place within a week.

items.question: Which industries do you cover?
items.answer: We specialize in tech, finance, healthcare, and professional services, and we recruit for a wide range of roles across operations, marketing, and leadership. If we're not the right fit, we'll tell you honestly.

items.question: Will you treat our candidates well?
items.answer: Absolutely. We believe a strong employer brand starts with how you treat every applicant. We give every candidate honest feedback and a positive experience, even when they don't get the job.
